fix(serving): stop attributing every rejection to Content Guard (plan 149)

publication_events.event_type='rejected' is emitted by three unrelated
paths: the frontend validation_result callback (real Content Guard
failure), database.release_article_publishing (pre-PR publish failure,
details reason/failure_class) and the reconciler's legacy_projection
repair (details source='legacy_projection'). The dashboard read model
selected on the event type alone and printed 'por Content Guard' for
every one of them.

- LifecycleRepository.count_publication_events_by_type_and_detail(): read
  aggregate filtering JSON details via the portable SQLAlchemy subscript
  (same idiom as article_repository); NULL/missing details never match.
- dashboard_health._validation_evidence(): counts stay per event type;
  the sentence attributes only the callback subset
  (details.event='validation_result') and otherwise reports the
  breakdown ('N rechazado(s) (X por Content Guard)').

Tests drive each real emitter (apply_validation_result, the release
path, the reconciler) and fail on the pre-change read model.
